findings.issue: The memory written is [1, 96, ceil32(len1)+128, len1, data1, len2, data2], but the text gives one Array whose data spans the string and the whole bytes argument and prints the bytes argument's head offset as a trailing third argument, so the call reads as having different arguments (same rendering fault as c00059's _become call).
findings.rule: Decode ABI call data by head/tail: each head word that is the offset of a (len, data) tail becomes its own Array(len, data) argument in head order; never fold a later tail into an earlier Array or move a head word after the tails.
